name: actc-refundable-single
description: The refundable Additional Child Tax Credit for a single filer with one child and almost no tax: the unused CTC pays out as the smaller of the per-child refundable cap ($1,700) and 15% of earned income over the $2,500 floor.

source.publication: Instructions for Schedule 8812 (2025), Additional Child Tax Credit worksheet lines 1-5; Instructions for Form 1040 (2025)
source.pin: Instructions for Schedule 8812 (2025) verbatim: 'the maximum amount you can claim for the ACTC is $1,700 per qualifying child'; worksheet line 2 'Number of qualifying children... x $1,700'; line 4 'Is the amount on line 3 more than $2,500? ... Subtract $2,500'; line 5 'Multiply the amount on line 4 by 15% (0.15)'.

derivation: Wages $12,000; standard deduction $15,750 exceeds income, so taxable income and tax are $0.
CTC $2,200 (one child); MAGI $12,000 is far below the $200,000 phase-out start, so no reduction.
Non-refundable CTC limited by tax before credits = $0; the full CTC is unused.
Total tax $0; refund = ACTC $1,425 paid out on the payments side of Form 1040.
